records.text:
openapi: 3.0.3
info:
  title: VulneraX Platform API
  description: |
    Unified Security Platform — SAST, DAST, SCA, Secrets, Container, IaC, Mobile, Firmware, Browser Extension, AI/LLM scanning.
    Risk Engine (CVSS + EPSS + KEV), Attack Path, AI Analyst, SBOM, Compliance, Pentest, Reporting.
  version: 1.0.0
  contact:
    name: VulneraX Team
servers:
  - url: http://localhost:8080
    description: Local development
  - url: https://vulnerax.example.com
    description: Production

security:
  - bearerAuth: []

components:
  securitySchemes:
    bearerAuth:
      type: http
      scheme: bearer
      bearerFormat: JWT

schemas:
    ApiResponse:
      type: object
      properties:
        success:
          type: boolean
        message:
          type: string
        data:
          type: object

paths:
  /api/v1/auth/login:
    post:
      tags: [Authentication]
      summary: Login and get JWT token
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/LoginRequest'
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Login successful
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                allOf:
                  - $ref: '#/components/schemas/ApiResponse'
                  - type: object
                    properties:
                      data:
                        $ref: '#/components/schemas/LoginResponse'

              type: object
              required: [email, password, fullName]

                email:
                  type: string
                password:
                  type: string
                fullName:
                  type: string
                role:
                  type: string
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Registration successful

records.text:
/api/v1/findings:
    get:
      tags: [Findings]
      summary: List findings with pagination
      parameters:
        - name: size
          in: query
          schema:
            type: integer
            default: 20
        - name: page
          in: query
          schema:
            type: integer
            default: 0
        - name: severity
          in: query
          schema:
            type: string
            enum: [CRITICAL, HIGH, MEDIUM, LOW, INFO]
        - name: status
          in: query
          schema:
            type: string
            enum: [OPEN, IN_PROGRESS, RESOLVED, FALSE_POSITIVE]
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Paginated findings
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                allOf:
                  - $ref: '#/components/schemas/ApiResponse'
                  - type: object
                    properties:
                      data:
                        $ref: '#/components/schemas/PageResponse'
